DIAGNOSIS READY: Adhesive Capsulitis (Frozen Shoulder)

The normal MRI result effectively rules out rotator cuff tears, calcific tendinitis, and other structural pathologies. Given your age, diabetes, and the classic presentation of global stiffness and pain that disrupts sleep and daily activities like brushing your hair, the clinical picture strongly points to adhesive capsulitis.
